scope: Local negative controls of publication verifier guard behavior using cloned actual readbacks. Mutated controls are never remote observations, approvals, product acceptance or framework verdicts.

checks.criterion: Actual unchanged full native readback passes exact source/metadata verification
Changing one original source character is rejected
Changing original source whitespace is rejected without normalization
Changing native lifecycle status is rejected
Changing the native parent is rejected
Changing a native blocked-by relation is rejected
Inventing an unobserved native estimate is rejected
Omitting an observed metadata field from a full GET is rejected
Adding an unknown native metadata field is rejected
Adding a non-description history event is rejected
A description event with an unrelated metadata key is rejected
Duplicating the proposed refinement section is rejected
Deleting the proposed refinement section is rejected
Changing a literal acceptance clause is rejected
Changing proposed scope text is rejected
Only an explicit appended description-only event is permitted
Partial update-response metadata is explicitly unverified and never substitutes for a full GET
A preobserved exact UUID/workspace/identifier native issue link is presentation only
Native issue link with unknown UUID is not normalized away
Native issue link with wrong host is not normalized away
Native issue link with changed visible identifier is not normalized away
Native issue link with query-bearing target is not normalized away
Changing a meaningful proposed threshold is not normalized away
The single exact historical empty-summary trailing space normalization creates no output text
